column3: NKJV has “the Jews who were not persuaded, becoming envious,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Jews, becoming jealous.”
NKJV has “to go to the sea,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to go as far as the sea.”
Close to the Greek; “full of idols” is rendered “given over to idols.”
NKJV has “the One whom … Him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the neuter “what … this.”
NKJV has “from one blood,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “from one.”
NKJV has “seek the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “seek God.”
